title: Organizing Combat Unit Behavior with State Machines
subtitle: This article dissects the state machine pattern for combat units, detailing how to decompose complex logic into independent state nodes. Readers will master constructing state transition tables to eliminate verbose conditional checks, enabling visual debugging and low-cost expansion while effectively resolving multi-behavior coupling challenges.
